title: SCIF world map briefing on borderless covert organization

tellings.quote: so in the skiff, a secure compartment information facility. I'm in there and there's a map on the wall

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who says UFO secrets are held by a hidden global group, says he was once inside a SCIF, a secure sealed room where classified information is discussed. He says there was a map of the world on the wall, used to brief him on a secret organisation that works across national borders. If true, it would mean the secrecy is run by a group answering to no single country.
